purpose: Source-qualified clean re-import from frozen BDM Solo and TMP Solo snapshots into a parallel PostgreSQL database.

context_resolution.rule: Resolve the company and branch codes independently, then require exactly one perusahaan_cabang pair. Never hard-code numeric IDs or infer ownership from cabang.id_perusahaan.

master_rules.principal: Create source-owned rows per source_system and company; never globally merge by code or name.

customer.bdm_share_tmp_only_when: normalized source customer code and normalized store name both match exactly
customer.otherwise: create a BDM source-owned customer; if global code uniqueness requires it, use a deterministic source prefix in the target display code

master_rules.sales: Key by source_system + source principal code + source sales code.
master_rules.product: Key by source_system + source principal code + source SKU.
master_rules.uom: Any base source UOM whose code/name is verified in frozen BarangSatuan is level 1/factor 1. A distinct verified outer source UOM is level 2 only when PerUnit is greater than 1. No PCS/CT semantic conversion is assumed; level 3 is allowed only with a complete verified factor chain.
master_rules.plafon: Use the latest source TglAdd only when values at the latest timestamp are consistent; otherwise write an import hold.

required: UOM composition and source-base quantity invariant
